description:
It was wonderful to see our Rotaractors participate in the CPR session held at Kapol Vidyanidhi College today, 29th October, conducted by Dr. Amola Parikh, along with Dr. Hema Dave and Dr. Varsha Vora, in collaboration with our Medical Team and Youth Team.

The session was both interesting and interactive, with our Rotaractors getting an opportunity to demonstrate what they had learnt.

It was truly heartening to see our youngsters learning such an important life-saving skill and understanding how timely action and a little knowledge can make all the difference in saving a life.

A big thank you to Dr. Amola Parikh, Dr. Hema Dave and Dr. Varsha Vora for taking the time to train our youngsters and help them become more aware and confident in responding to emergencies.

Our sincere thanks to PP Sunita Hirlekar for coordinating with the college and helping make this session possible.
